segments.text:
BLeſſed Lorde, whiche haſte cauſed all holy ſcriptures to be writtē for our learning: graunt vs that we maye in ſuche wyſe heare them, reade, marke, learne, and inwardly digeſte them, that by pacience and
coumforte of thy holy woorde, we maye embrace and euer holde faſt the bleſſed hope of euerlaſting lyfe, whiche thou haſte geuen vs in our ſauiour Ieſus Chriſte.
